products.name: Helles Lager
products.description: 5% ABV · 15 IBU · We make our Helles Lager using the classic European noble hops Hallertauer and Saaz, synonymos with traditional European style. Pale gold and clear in the glass, it opens with a soft, bready malt nose and gentle floral hop notes. The body is smooth and light, with low bitterness that lets the malt shine. Crisp, balanced and easy-drinking, it finishes clean and refreshing.

products.name: Session IPA
products.description: 3.8% ABV · 25 IBU · A juicy, unfiltered and all-natural Session IPA bursting with fresh fruit aromas. Ripe mango and grapefruit lead the palate, delivering big hop flavour without the heaviness. A blended base of rolled oats, flaked wheat and malted barley gives a surprisingly full-bodied, smooth mouthfeel. Low in alcohol but full of character, it fnishes bight, refreshing and easy to come back to.

products.name: Valletta
products.description: 4.8% ABV · 35 IBU · Valletta 2018 is a bright and pleasant bottom-fermented lager, named after Malta's capital. Golden and clear in the glass, it opens with a clean, gently malty nose. The body is light and smooth, letting the delicate bitterness of the hops come through without overpowering the malt. A subtle citrus note lingers on the aftertaste, making it an easy-drinking, refreshing lager that finishes crisp and clean.

products.name: IPA
products.description: 5.8% ABV · 50 IBU · Our Indian Pale Ale is brewed with four hop additions to create a powerfull hop profile. A solid malt base, however, tempers the bitter American hops, giving our IPA a balance not often found in this style. The end product is a well-balanced, malty beer with the crisp taste of hops and an exceptionally frity nose.
